text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear thinking. First, time management is essential. Make a schedule that shows when each task must be finished. Second, learn prioritization: decide which tasks are most important and do them first. Third, practice scope management. If a project is too big, agree to reduce it instead of trying to do everything. Finally, communication matters. Tell your team or manager early if a deadline is at risk, so they can help. When you combine these four habits, you can meet deadlines with less stress and produce better work.
